pitch_angle: Empirical thermal comfort study: Rammed earth vs RCC in Western India summer heat.
pitch_subject: Editorial story pitch for ArchDaily South Asia: Empirical thermal comfort study
pitch_body:
Hi there, hope you're having a good week.

I'm Archana, principal architect at Anvitam Architecture & Ecological Design. I've been following ArchDaily South Asia's coverage on sustainable habitats and vernacular building.

We recently documented a completed case study on: Empirical thermal comfort study: Rammed earth vs RCC in Western India summer heat..

We have the high-res photography, thermal data sets, and architectural working drawings ready. I'd love to share the full package as an exclusive editorial contribution or guest feature for ArchDaily South Asia if this fits your upcoming editorial calendar.

A brief look at our completed work: https://www.anvitam.com/projects

If your editorial lineup is currently full, no problem at all. Feel free to keep us in mind for future ecological design stories.

Warmly,
Archana Gavas
Principal Architect, Anvitam Architecture & Ecological Design

name: Jennifer Lee
why_targeted: Global architectural practices frequently outsource drafting, while private investors seek authoritative guidance to de-risk high-ticket projects.
source_name: Commercial Sector Research & Verified Domain Directory
subject: A quick introduction — Anvitam
body:
Hi Jennifer,

I came across Napa Valley Vineyard Estates and wanted to reach out and introduce myself.

I'm Archana, Founder and Principal Architect at Anvitam. We work across sustainable architecture, landscape planning, and regenerative design, with a focus on creating thoughtful spaces that respond to the land, nature, and the people who use them.

Our work spans homes, farms, retreats, eco-homestays, hospitality spaces, and larger landscape and land-planning projects.

I always enjoy connecting with people working on interesting projects, and I thought it would be lovely to get to know your work as well. Perhaps there's an opportunity to collaborate on a future project, exchange ideas, or support each other along the way.

Would love to stay in touch and see where our work might align.

You can explore our work here: https://anvitam.com

Warm regards,
Archana Gavas
Founder & Principal Architect
Anvitam
